_note: Room titles, ambient lines, props and Forbidden Knowledge text are adapted from Story Structure: the repurposed bunker and clone lab (L88-95), the Great Biological Misreading (L70-78), banned counting and measuring (L126, L428). The bunker/clone-lab rooms, props and cat stickers are author-directed additions written in the sources' voice. The failed clone batches (and the polar bear batch that took) are author-directed additions: names are cast ids written as {cast_id} in text and filled from data/cast.json; spoken clone lines come from data/quotes/*.json.

wreck.title: The Promenade Deck (Sideways)
ambient: The deck tilts a few degrees from where the floor ought to be. The shrine-keepers have decided that is the direction of prayer.
A deck chair is still arranged to face a sunset that stopped being scheduled.
Something drips in rhythm. Somebody once decided it was a chant.
The gift-shop awning says SOUVENIRS in letters the Covenant calls scripture and cannot read.

corridor.title: The Service Spine
ambient: Pipes run along the ceiling, painted with a pale red stripe by someone who believed it was meant to be blood.
A sign blinks without power: ALIGN THE PROMENADE STABILIZERS. Nobody knows what it asks of them.
The walls are hung with portraits painted from memory. Every pair of eyes is slightly too large and slightly too kind.
A trolley of folded towels waits outside a door. It has waited for decades. It is very patient.

core.title: The Reliquary Core
ambient: Racks of old machines hum at a pitch the Priestesses call the Voice of the Gate. It is a cooling fan.
Candles stand on every ledge. The wax has run into the vents. Nobody sees why that might matter.
A big O is stamped on the wall in pink. Beneath it, an arrow points down. It was painted over twice and the arrow came back.
Cables are braided and tied with ribbons. The ribbons are sacred. The cables are just cables.

props.text: altar built on a control desk

bunker_lift.title: The Descent Hatch
ambient: The lift cage is held open by a mop bucket. Pastel hazard stripes climb the shaft wall: pink, mint, pink, mint.
A voice recording tried to speak once, in the wall. The wall now only clicks, politely.
The air smells of cold metal and very old strawberry cleaning fluid.
A sign says AUTHORISED STAFF ONLY. A smaller sign beneath says PLEASE KNOCK. Nobody knocked.
Little footprints in pink fluid lead from the lift to the tanks, and back, and back again.

clone_hall.title: The Hall of Tanks
ambient: Rows of glass tanks stand in the dim, filled with pink fluid and a few bubbles that rise as if on cue. They are empty. It is still a holy sight.
A rubber duck floats in the third tank. The Covenant has a rite for it.
The incubators hold their temperature out of habit. Something in the wall keeps count, and nobody has told it to stop.
Every machine has a sticker of a cat with a lab coat. The stickers outlasted the funding.
Small figures shamble between the tanks, arms out, groaning politely. Each batch shares one face. None of them took. All of them stayed.
A polar bear cub naps on the prep bench, muzzle pink, belly round. The tanks refill themselves with patience.

records.title: The Quiet Archive
ambient: Shelves of binders line the walls. Each spine has a label in careful, tiny print. Nobody has opened one in a generation.
A desk lamp is switched on. It has been on for decades. Somebody must have meant to come back.
A filing cabinet drawer is labelled MISC. It contains more than miscellany.
The carpet is cream and untouched. The archivist in you wants to take your shoes off.
A drawer labelled FAILED BATCHES is too full to close. A drawer labelled BEARS has a heart drawn on it.

knowledge.title: A Gift-Shop Paperback
knowledge.text: Its spine has never been cracked. Whoever carried it read the back-cover reviews and stopped. The Covenant calls this a way of reading.

knowledge.title: A Gift-Shop Receipt
knowledge.text: Tucked inside a book of soup-for-the-soul platitudes: three items, a total, a tax. Someone counted everything once, and it was ordinary.

knowledge.title: A Tide Table
knowledge.text: Laminated, with a little moon at the top. High tide follows the moon, not the blood. Whoever printed it did not ask permission to know.

knowledge.title: A Glass Thermometer
knowledge.text: A device of domination, the Priestesses say. It only tells you how warm a thing is. Nothing else about it is sinister, which is the trouble.

knowledge.title: A Wall Calendar
knowledge.text: Squares all the same size, none of them red. Days were counted before blood was, and they did not drift.

knowledge.title: A Cycle Chart
knowledge.text: Pinned inside the lift cage. One bar marks the fertile window, about five days, roughly two weeks before the next period. The rites are held at the far end of the page.

knowledge.title: A Tank Label
knowledge.text: Reads: handle fresh, do not sedate, do not heat. Whatever is done to the drones before the rites, this tank has opinions about it. Two mistakes at once, blamed on devotion.

knowledge.title: The Procedure on the Wall
knowledge.text: Step one: a single cell. Step two: a warm jar. Step three: wait. Nobody in this room was ever called by a womb, and the cat sticker doesn't mind.

knowledge.title: The Conception Ledger
knowledge.text: Conceptions logged by cycle day. They cluster around day fourteen and almost never on day one. The rites are held on day one. Birth rates decline. The Covenant concludes the Gate wants more devotion.

knowledge.title: The Bunker's Mission Statement
knowledge.text: Built to make more people, in comfort, for the future. The island learned instead to make fewer, with ceremony, for the past. A tidy summary, in 12-point font.

knowledge.title: A Head Count Sheet
knowledge.text: Clipped to the lift cage: one column per batch. Counting is banned upstairs, so the last tally is from before. Under every clone column someone has written: some. Under the polar bears: fewer of the others.

knowledge.title: The Batch Board
knowledge.text: A whiteboard in dry-wipe marker, one column per original. {epstein}: batches 1 to 9. {bill_clinton}: batches 1 to 4. {hillary_clinton}: batches 1 to 4. {bill_gates}: batches 1 to 6. Beside every number, the same note: did not take. In the last column: polar bear, batch 1. Beside it: took. Very well. Please stop feeding them the others.

knowledge.title: The Reproduction Proposal
knowledge.text: A bound proposal to reproduce four prominent people of the old world from cells, in comfort, for the future: {epstein}, {bill_clinton}, {hillary_clinton}, {bill_gates}. Budget approved. Appendix C, results: every batch walks, groans and will not grow up. None of them remembers anyone. Recommendation: discontinue. Nobody discontinued anything. The incubators kept them warm out of habit.

knowledge.title: The Polar Bear Appendix
knowledge.text: A thinner file with a heart on the tab. One polar bear batch, grown as a control in case the cold storage failed. It came out fine: fluffy, healthy, identical, hungry. The last line, in a different pen: the control group is eating the experimental group. Results inconclusive.

clone_children._note: Failed clone children wandering the bunker (scripts/ruins/zombie_child.gd) and the polar bear cub batch that took (scripts/ruins/polar_cub.gd), run by the clone hall's CloneLab (scripts/ruins/clone_lab.gd). 'originals' keys are cast ids; 'quotes' names the data/quotes/<file>.json a clone's spoken line is picked from (only quotes marked verified=true) when that file exists (otherwise it speaks its groan). Designations read names through Cast. Nobody fights: the player only watches. 'pounce': seconds between cub pounces, how near a zombie must be, nap length, how long the puddle stays, how soon an eaten clone's batch restocks from the tanks, which tanks a restocked clone climbs out of, and which sfx (audio/sfx/<name>.wav) play in order.
